# master-nodes

Kubelet tuning for control-plane nodes

```yaml
stack:
  masterNodes:
    enabled: true
```

## Settings

Kubelet reservations. They size the control plane and vary per cluster.

Under `stack.masterNodes.config`. Maps merge across layers; lists are replaced whole.

| Key | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `maxPods` | Maximum pods per node | `250` |
| `systemReservedMemory` | Memory reserved for the OS | `3Gi` |
| `systemReservedCpu` | CPU reserved for the OS | `500m` |
| `kubeReservedMemory` | Memory reserved for kubelet and the container runtime | `1536Mi` |
| `kubeReservedCpu` | CPU reserved for kubelet and the container runtime | `500m` |
| `evictionMemory` | Hard eviction threshold on available memory | `500Mi` |

## Policies

`<cluster>` is the ManagedCluster name, or hubName on the hub. `global.remediationAction: inform` overrides every action below.

Standards: NIST SP 800-53. Controls: CM-6 Configuration Settings. Categories: CM Configuration Management.

### Policy `config`

`config-master-nodes-<cluster>`: Control-plane kubelet configuration.

| Template | Action | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config-master-kubelet` | enforce | [node-kubelet-config](converters/node-kubelet-config.yaml) | KubeletConfig for the master pool |
